newsitem.title: POLAND: KREDYT PUSHES BACK ISSUES TO APRIL.
newsitem.headline: KREDYT PUSHES BACK ISSUES TO APRIL.

text.p: Polish Kredyt Bank SA has pushed back planned share issues for the general public and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) to April from February and March respectively, the bank said.
Kredyt Bank said in a statement on Monday that its planned public offering of between 7.5 million and 10 million shares would take place from April 7 to April 11.
It had previously planned the issue's two-million-share retail tranche and eight-million-share large-investor tranche to take place from February 17 to February 21.
The bank also said the EBRD would be offered 635,000 to 847,000 shares on April 28 and April 29 rather than the previously planned March 17 to March 19.
Kredyt Bank currently has 25.6 million shares outstanding.
It gave no reasons for the moving of the issues but said more details would be available in the issues' prospectus.
